name: 愤怒铁拳
description: 选择敌人（1），造成4次0.25倍伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,t=selectTarget({type:'piece',range:1,filter:'enemy'});if(!t||t.needsTargetSelection)return t;var total=0;for(var i=0;i<4;i++){var r=dealDamage(c,t,Math.floor(c.attack*.25),'physical',battle,context.skill.id);total+=r.damage||0;}return{success:true,message:c.name+'连续挥拳造成'+total+'点伤害'};}
